title: Fleet Radar: keep the fleet honest
audience: Maintainers who need a compact view of repository freshness and blockers without inventing readiness or mutating the repositories being observed.
promise: Register explicit repositories, preserve each native receipt and freshness state, follow the blocker to its owner, and refresh a bounded snapshot read-only.

contract_distinctions.upstream_projection: Fleet Radar consumes producer receipts without inventing status; producer target, outcome, freshness, and contract state remain visible in the snapshot.
contract_distinctions.native_follow_up: Every blocker points back to its receipt or source location and carries a concrete next action; direct tool opening is a separate proof gate.

story: An explicit registry names repositories and preserves their identities.
A fresh passing receipt and a failed stale receipt remain separate cards with a visible attention item.
The shared evidence envelope and supported producer receipts are classified without flattening malformed, mixed, mismatched, or unsupported contracts.
Every unresolved check carries a native source-location link or local-receipt fallback plus a next action.
Missing receipts, unavailable paths, duplicate identities, dirty worktrees, refresh races, and aggregate readiness remain visible boundaries rather than inferred health.
A second refresh rewrites only the bounded Fleet Radar snapshot while observed repository refs remain unchanged.
verified_locally: Real CLI refresh over an explicit two-repository fixture registry.
Fresh ready and stale failed native receipts remain in the attention view.
Shared-envelope and producer-receipt contract states project into the snapshot.
Blockers expose native source-location or local-receipt follow-up links.
Unavailable, unreadable, duplicate, mixed-schema, dirty, and refresh-race cases remain actionable.
A repeated refresh leaves both repository refs unchanged.
Source tests, lint, package, JSON, and CLI checks pass.
The candidate preview is rendered as a visually inspected 1600×900 PNG.
The case page builds, passes rendered-HTML tests, passes lint and Pre-CR, and is saved as a Sites version; public access remains pending.
Current-dev CLI refresh reads readiness-inspector and rule-lab from the configured registry, preserving fresh, dirty, missing, and unknown-freshness states.
open_gates: Read two real portfolio producer receipts through a configured registry.
Capture native deep-link navigation to the owning blocker.
Confirm public access, deploy the saved Sites version, and fetch the case URL without credentials.
claim_boundary: This is a current-dev candidate packet for explicit-registry freshness projection, receipt-contract classification, native-link metadata, broad local failure states, and a verified binary preview. A validated owner-only Sites version is saved, but the packet does not claim two healthy real producer receipts, direct tool launching, a no-auth URL, or public publication.
